root_cause.text: In f2fs_compress_write_end_io(), dec_page_count(sbi, type) is called before the final accesses to sbi (page_array_free and kmem_cache_free), enabling a concurrent unmount to free sbi and its slab cache while the completion callback still dereferences them.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and CVE description state: "dec_page_count(sbi, type) can bring the F2FS_WB_CP_DATA counter to zero, unblocking f2fs_wait_on_all_pages() in f2fs_put_super()... The unmount path then proceeds to call f2fs_destroy_page_array_cache(sbi), which destroys sbi->page_array_slab... Meanwhile, the bio completion callback is still executing: when it reaches page_array_free(sbi, ...), it dereferences sbi->page_array_slab — a destroyed slab cache — to call kmem_cache_free(), causing a use-after-free." The fix moves dec_page_count() to after page_array_free() and kmem_cache_free() in the last-folio path, ensuring all sbi accesses complete before the counter decrement.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix page count decrement in compression write completion to avoid erroneously decrementing when the last pending page completes.
intent_record.what: Moved the `dec_page_count(sbi, type)` call from before the `if (atomic_dec_return(&cic->pending_pages))` check to inside the if block, so that `dec_page_count` is only executed when there are still pending pages.
intent_record.how: Previously, `dec_page_count` was called unconditionally before checking the atomic decrement. Now it is called only when `atomic_dec_return` returns non-zero (still pending pages). When the last pending page completes (returns 0), `dec_page_count` is not called, which corrects the page count accounting for the I/O completion path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a potential use-after-free race condition in f2fs by moving dec_page_count to the end of f2fs_compress_write_end_io
intent_record.what: Add a call to `dec_page_count(sbi, type)` at the end of `f2fs_compress_write_end_io`, after freeing resources, with a comment explaining that this must be the last access to sbi to prevent a race with unmount.
intent_record.how: The change ensures that the reference count (F2FS_WB_CP_DATA) is decremented only after all other uses of sbi have completed, preventing the unmount thread from destroying sbi while the function is still accessing its fields.

candidates.rationale: This call to dec_page_count is placed before the final accesses to sbi (page_array_free and kmem_cache_free). A concurrent unmount can observe the decremented count and free sbi, causing a use-after-free when the later accesses dereference sbi.
This statement accesses sbi after dec_page_count has been called. If a concurrent unmount frees sbi due to the earlier decrement, this dereference becomes a use-after-free.

Similar to page_array_free, this statement also uses sbi (via cic_entry_slab, which is a slab cache allocated from sbi) after dec_page_count, and is vulnerable if sbi has been freed by a concurrent unmount.
